ideas.title: Investigation into FBI Handling of Alex Pretti Shooting
ideas.description: This story would investigate the FBI's handling of the Alex Pretti shooting, including their refusal to share evidence with Minnesota officials.
questions: What are the reasons behind the FBI's refusal to share evidence?
Are there any larger issues at play in this case?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger scandal or cover-up, and could lead to further investigations and accountability.
